start_protocol: controlled drop from conservative default-pose envelope, not pre-settled fallen poses
time_definition: onset of the first stable interval held for hold_s; simulation includes hold_s after horizon_s
criterion: gravity error < 0.35, height 0.30-0.55 m, speed < 0.50 m/s, angular speed < 1.00 rad/s, 4 foot contacts > 5 N, no base contact, feet on correct body sides (0.06 < signed lateral < 0.30 m), knees on correct sides (>0.04 m), fore/hind feet on correct ends (>0.08 m), each joint offset <0.65 rad; all continuously held for hold_s
